verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company formation, compliance and bookkeeping SaaS, so surfacing AI-generated insights from a user's company or financial data is a fair question for it. The pack only mentions "AI-powered, human-managed bookkeeping," which describes how the books are kept, not AI insights or suggestions delivered to the user in-product. The compliance dashboard shows status and deadlines but is not described as AI-generated, so neither counts toward this story.
